##### Project general facts

Reportage Village Khalifa City is a masterpiece infused with a contemporary Italian touch. Featuring a collection of thoughtfully designed townhouses, this development strives to create a luxurious lifestyle in the beautiful capital. Surrounded by parks, schools, mosques, and community retail outlets, the project creates a vibrant and convenient neighborhood where residents can open up to life and breathe the luxury of living among lush greens.

Each townhouse is designed with spaciousness and a touch of privacy, featuring well-lit rooms and private parking slots for each unit. Private balconies or terraces, maid rooms in select townhouses, private swimming pools, and optional internal elevators ensure a comfortable and upscale living experience for all residents. Whether escaping the heat or relishing in the joy of a poolside gathering, this is a place where memories are made, shared, and kept.

Every residence at Reportage Village Khalifa City features modern finishing with high-quality materials, fully tiled bathrooms, central air conditioning, and fully equipped kitchens with cabinets and countertops. Vanity units and mirrors complete the thoughtful design, creating a living space that is both functional and elegant.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Khalifa City, a prominent residential area in Abu Dhabi known for its peaceful environment and modern amenities, this exceptional location offers a suburban lifestyle with the convenience of proximity to the city center. Located to the southeast of the capital, this well-planned community is divided into sections offering a variety of housing options ranging from villas to apartments.

The location is distinguished by its lush parks, reputable schools, mosques, and a range of retail outlets, providing a family-friendly atmosphere. Wide, tree-lined streets and spacious properties make it a popular choice for families and expatriates seeking a tranquil yet well-connected living environment. Healthcare facilities and sports clubs further enhance the quality of life for residents.

For those seeking a residence that embodies contemporary elegance, community connection, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Khalifa City delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of suburban charm, modern amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the capital's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — tranquil, connected and effortlessly refined.
